subject: a transparent half-dome library on a floating grass islet
art_direction: 透明半球书馆落在悬空小岛上，木肋和无字书架透出暖光，深浅蓝天光留白自然。
visible_description: 透明半球书馆落在悬空小岛上，木肋和无字书架透出暖光，深浅蓝天光留白自然。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Create a transparent half-dome library on a floating grass islet. Keep the dome as a simple clear form with timber ribs, showing only indistinct unmarked shelves inside. The island has a clean grassy top and a compact stone underside. Warm interior light glows near the entrance. The upper fifth remains open sky, with no stars, aircraft, or additional islands. Use detailed speculative landscape illustration. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
